# Covert

Covert renders Obsidian in a deep, low-contrast dark palette that makes text hard to read from a distance, which is its stated privacy purpose. Commented CSS variables are exposed for color tweaks, and the theme states that notes stay plain text with no encryption, so anyone with device access can read them.

![Covert screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/schrunchee/obsidian-covert-theme/HEAD/obsidian_covert_theme_sm3.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Covert"
    author: "schrunchee"
    repo:   "schrunchee/obsidian-covert-theme"
    slug:   "covert"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/covert"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/schrunchee/obsidian-covert-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/schrunchee/obsidian-covert-theme/HEAD/obsidian_covert_theme_sm3.jpg"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Render Obsidian with a deep, low-contrast dark palette that makes text hard to read from a distance for added on-screen privacy. Expose commented CSS variables for easy color tweaks and keep notes as plain text with no encryption—anyone with device access can read them."
}
```
